activity.notes: Kenneth Kaunda became the first President of independent Zambia on 24 October 1964 and served until the democratic transfer of power in November 1991.

sources.title: Kenneth Kaunda Bio
sources.citation_text: Zambia's Cabinet Office identifies Kaunda as the first President of Zambia from 1964 to 1991 and states that he became president on independence day, 24 October 1964.

sources.title: Presidents — Cabinet Office Zambia
sources.citation_text: The Zambian Cabinet Office lists Kenneth Kaunda as the first president, serving from 1964 to 1991.
